judgments.rationale: The proposal merges the mandatory content requirement of clause (ii) into the permission record for clause (i). Clause (i) and clause (ii) are distinct statutory provisions, where clause (ii) imposes a mandatory requirement that is already independently captured in claim C0001. Conflating them within C0000 improperly embeds an independent requirement into a permission record.

The proposal accurately populates the missing action ('inspect') and object ('public records') and isolates the temporal qualification ('during opening hours') as a scope condition, fully supported by the text of clause (i) in passage F003.

The proposal improperly aggregates distinct statutory provisions from clauses (i), (ii), and (iii) into C0000, and it factually contradicts passage F002 by stating that applicants must publish annual statistics, whereas the source text places that obligation solely on the agency.

The proposal completes the missing action ('submit') and object ('a request electronically') directly from the source text of clause (i) in passage F000 while faithfully preserving the permission modality and actor.
